items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the long exact sequence of Ext groups in the contravariant variable from a short exact sequence of modules (statement lines 17876-17896). The proof does not construct the connecting maps by hand: it builds a map between two free presentations adapted to the given sequence, applies the Hom functor into the fixed module, checks that the resulting sequence of complexes is short exact, and finishes with the snake lemma (proof lines 17898-17938). Adapting the presentations so that the comparison exists is the step that carries the construction. H2.
